name: Ordered advance followed by downside damage
scope: Fixed cross-year original account extrema and prior mechanism counterexamples. No account, full-universe ranking, parameter grid or native signal rerun.
case_selection: PVR existing fully closed original rounds: highest and lowest net PnL per entry year 2022..2026; 2026 only through known endpoint, not a complete year. Plus fixed known 600056 2022-03-30, 002317 2022-10-14, 300182 2022-01-04, 002385 2022-03-04, 600606 2022-03-22, 688582 2024-07-29; plus 300085 2024-09-19 and 2024-10-09, 002583 2024-09-19 (signal path examples, not all original fills). Outcomes known in advance, deliberately not a predictive sample.
clock: At each close t, original native same-segment close and return only; sigma_t=sqrt(mean prior63 r^2), floor log(1.001), current r excluded. Source segment or a missing common date invalidates state and requires 63 returns warmup again. I/CP resets never reset price memory.
rho: 20/21; use existing 21 observation scale without selection
advance: U_t=max(0,rho*U_(t-1)+r_t); U initialized 0 at first valid return within each source block, even during scale warmup
damage: a_t=U_(t-1)/(U_(t-1)+sqrt(21)*sigma_t); H_t=rho*H_(t-1)+(1-rho)*a_t*(max(-r_t,0)/sigma_t)^2. H initialized 0 at segment start; H unknown until sigma available, then accumulates with explicit warm-start. Require at least 63 warm observations after sigma first known before calling fully warmed, but report short warm separately rather than deleting.
continuous_state: healthy=1/(1+H); fresh_weight=healthy*(1-a); established_weight=healthy*a; damaged_weight=1-healthy. They sum to one, descriptive weights NOT success probabilities. No state threshold, no current-high resistance, no favorable-volume interpretation.
policy: Native E0/G/I/CP permissions and PVR priority unchanged. If empty and fresh original I/CP actionable, probe risk b=.001*known_equity*healthy/(1+same_stock_realized_loss_debt/(.005*equity)); no later evidence is required for direct acceleration. On reentry same persistent H and realized debt apply; no fixed cooldown and no stale CP reuse. Add only on a distinct fresh CP, existing same-stock net liquidation PnL > 0 at both signal close and executable next open; old shares must already exist, no averaging down. Initial campaign principal-risk cap never grows from an add. Add allowed risk <= min(.0025*E,.5*positive_old_mark_net,initial_principal_cap+old_stress_net)*healthy. Native CORE/MOBILE exits and floors remain separate; do not apply CP exit to CORE implicitly.
budget: Reuse previously disclosed shared trial consumption bucket, not claim novelty: initial .01*E; refill .0001*prior_E/common day; cap .01*prior_E; all actual loss fully debited, half actual realized profits credited; negative debt retained, all pending risk reserved. Actual gap can exceed stress budget.
sizing: At close freeze qcap with original role floor and dated cost model. For next permitted open O, replace signal mark by O and shrink only: max valid board-lot q satisfying q*(O-X)+buyfee(q,O)+sellfee(q,X)<=b and cash/name/portfolio caps. X uses prior known native role floor and prior risk scale. If O<=role floor refuse. No next H/L/C/A in admission. First-day T+1/gap/limit fills not certified by this case check.
main_question: Does ordered damage separate original launch from terminal re-impulse without universally punishing volatility expansion? It may not improve binary closed-round win rate at all; sizing effect cannot be advertised as 35% selection success.
falsifiers: Keep counterexamples where a failed signal has higher healthy than a winner; also preserve low-health winners and late acceleration that still has health near 1. Do not choose a cutoff or tune rho, scale window, state transform or budget after observing cases. No aggregate return or win-rate claim from selected cases.
